_comment: Which Pokemon Crystal apworld versions pack.sh bundles, per channel.
The newest version of a channel is always the submodule's checked-out tree
(that is also what the YAML creator and the nav version chip are built
from). `older` lists extra git refs from the same repo to bundle alongside
it, for playing seeds the newest version can no longer take: a stable
release that changed the ROM checksum, or a prerelease outside the newest
minimum_patch_version window. Versions inside the newest one's compatibility
window don't need listing; the newest plays their seeds.
